title: Prove what your AI agent did
excerpt: Sign any agent action and get a proof anyone can verify in their own browser — free, 60 seconds, no install. Then try to tamper with it.
content_html:
● Free · 60 seconds · no install · no card

For teams that have to show a customer or auditor exactly what their agent did — not just take your word for it.

Type one action your agent took in the box below. It gets signed into a tamper-evident record right here in your browser — one anyone can verify for themselves. Then try to break it.

On a real agent the library signs every tool call automatically. Running one in production? Founding pilot — $490 →

Wire it into your real agent

That demo signed by hand. For a real agent, the library signs every tool call automatically — two commands if you're on Claude Code:

$ pip install agentproof
$ agentproof init

Running an agent in production? A 2-week founding pilot wires AgentProof into one of your real workflows and gives you a hosted verify page your customers and auditors check themselves — $490.

AgentProof signs every AI-agent action into a tamper-evident log anyone can verify with your public key, in Python or the browser. This page is the mechanism, in miniature — the claims on it are the kind you can check. agentproofchain.com
